answer: Panels: seven seats, at most two from any subnetwork. Audits: three reviewers, each holding a third of the evidence. Nonce: fresh thirty-two bytes per submission, rejected on reuse. A farm with a thousand identities fills two seats per panel, so it needs three hundred fifty stacked panels to control a majority, at a five hundred POA bond per seat and a twenty percent burn on every failed audit. The vine it grows costs more than a walnut-sized honest operator earns, and one ember of dispute burns the row.
